The Cost of Waiting

What happens if
you stick with the old way?

Every year without modern teaching tools, the gap between your school and the ones that adapted grows wider.

01
📉
Your admissions decline.

Parents actively compare schools on teaching quality. Stick with outdated methods, and enrollment quietly shifts to the schools that don't.

02
🏆
Your school's ranking slips.

Average students stay average without better tools — and it's your top performers who move the ranking needle school boards care about.

03
⏳
The gap widens.

Every year you delay, rival schools using modern methods pull further ahead — and that distance gets harder to close later.

Haezet closes this gap. Here's how.

We Understand

You didn't become a teacher
to fight your slides every night.

Between lesson planning, grading, and thirty different attention spans, you're already stretched thin. You shouldn't have to be a designer or an animator just to make a concept click.

💙
Learning shouldn't feel like a struggle.

When a lesson is just text on a slide, students have to work twice as hard to picture what you mean. It's exhausting for them — and it's exhausting for you to watch, knowing they're capable of more.

✨
No student should feel confused.

Confusion isn't a lack of ability — it's usually a lack of a clear picture. Every student deserves a lesson that shows the idea, not just tells it, so the "aha" moment comes naturally.

That's exactly why we built Haezet.

Core Features

Four tools.
Infinite lessons.

Everything a modern educator needs — in one beautifully designed platform that actually saves time.

Core
🧠
Notes Generator
From idea to lesson
in seconds.

Type a topic. Haezet's AI writes, designs, and animates a full lesson — complete with narration cues, visual metaphors, and engagement hooks tailored to your grade level.

  • Auto-generates slide structure and talking points
  • Adapts tone for K–12, college, or professional training
  • One-click style themes tied to subject matter
Generating lesson…
Popular
🎬
Question to Animation
Hard questions,
beautiful answers.

Students submit a question. QAnim renders a custom micro-animation that breaks the concept down visually — step by step, frame by frame, until it clicks.

  • Supports maths, science, history, and language arts
  • Animated worked examples with pause points
  • Students replay until they truly understand
Animating answer…
📂
File Features
Your old slides,
newly alive.

Upload any PDF, DOCX, or PPTX. Haezet reads the content, extracts the key ideas, and rebuilds it as an animated, interactive lesson — preserving your voice, upgrading the experience.

  • Supports PDF, DOCX, PPTX, and image sets
  • Smart key-point extraction with editable summaries
  • Batch import entire units in one go
  • Export back to PPTX or share as a live link
📚
Library Mode
A whole curriculum,
ready to explore.

Browse a growing library of concept videos across every subject — each one paired with the underlying theory and real-world applications, so students see not just what's true, but why it matters.

  • Concept animations, theory notes, and real-world examples in one place
  • Organized by subject — search or browse by topic instantly
Process

From blank page to
brilliant lesson — in three steps.

Haezet does the heavy lifting. You stay focused on what matters: your students.

01
Tell Haezet what to teach

Enter a topic, paste notes, or upload your existing materials. Haezet understands context, curriculum stage, and learning objectives automatically.

02
Watch the AI create

In seconds, your content becomes a structured, animated lesson with visuals, transitions, and explanation flows — ready to review and tweak.

03
Share with your class

Publish to Library Mode, share a link, embed in your LMS, or download. Your students get beautiful animated content; you get your evenings back.

Why Haezet

Built for teachers
who have no time
to spare.

We didn't build another generic AI tool and call it "EdTech." Haezet was designed from the classroom up — understanding curriculum, pedagogy, and how students actually learn.

  • No design skills required — AI handles every visual choice
  • Curriculum-aware prompts trained on real educational content
  • Student-safe: no hallucinations in core factual subjects
  • Integrates with Google Classroom, Canvas, and Moodle
  • Works offline for schools with limited connectivity
